paragraphs: I am a software engineer and technology strategist who moves between shipping code and shaping the business case behind it. My path runs from enterprise SSD firmware at Micron to fulfillment-technology tooling at Amazon, and now to AI market strategy at NYU Stern's Endless Frontier Labs.

On the build side, I ship consumer-facing products: a conversational food-ordering app with mood detection on Node.js and Gemini 2.5 Flash, and a privacy-first Flutter utility that holds a 5.0 Play Store rating.

At Micron I held a sub-1-second SLA on firmware activation for Dell and HP, built a centralized test automation framework across 100+ concurrent setups, and onboarded and mentored 10 engineers. I was promoted from Software Engineer to Senior Software Engineer within 24 months.

Outside of work I was a Mitacs Globalink Research Fellow at ÉTS Montréal and write articles on AI and software engineering for Bootcamp on Medium and dev.to. I am pursuing an MS in Engineering Management at NYU.
